caption: The video captures a first-person view riding down an escalator through a neon-lit mall court, with a yellow overlay reading '新加坡裕廊坊香港街 2022' at the top left. Overhead hang glowing signs—a vertical yellow-and-red placard, a green-and-red '紅珊瑚' board, a yellow '新明星' sign, and an orange 'POPULAR' banner—all drifting upward as the camera descends. A masked man in a white T-shirt stands close on the left and slides out of view, while a man leaning on the left handrail remains partly visible. On the right a masked man props himself on the railing and looks down throughout. At the bottom a person in a red shirt and beige trousers stands among shop fronts, then partly hidden behind the curving central handrail as a rack of light clothing comes into view. Glass balustrades on both sides mirror the scene, and the steady descent continues without a clear start or finish.
